purpose: Execution surfaces below Strategy. Main Agent supports only renderer-level CDP and browser-native control. Browser UI / OS physical input remains an external experimental subsystem.

page-cdp.notes: In-page pointer/keyboard/scroll/form/media execution through allowlisted CDP primitives.

browser-native.notes: Deterministic browser/tab/navigation control through CDP Page domain and browser control-plane APIs.

selectionRule: Use page-cdp for webpage interaction and browser-native for browser/tab/navigation control. Main Agent must not escalate to physical Browser UI / OS input.
strategyBoundary: Strategy must not emit executionSurface, surface, executionVariant, mechanism, controlLease, HWND, screen coordinates, raw tab/window identity, or raw protocol packets.

browser-ui-os.reason: Windows UI Automation + Win32 SendInput owns shared physical desktop input and remains outside the production Agent boundary until a separate explicit integration decision.
